collections.schedule: Second and fourth Wednesday, April 1 through December 10

setout_rule: Not before 6:00 pm the evening before your pickup day.
bring_in_rule: Bring containers back in as soon as you can after collection.
container_rule: Trash needs to go in a rodent-proof container with a lid that closes, kept out of sight. Bags on their own do not survive the night — animals get into them and the mess ends up on the street.

not_accepted: Limbs over 4 feet long or 4 inches thick
yard_waste.bundling: Bundle branches with rope or string, or put them in paper yard-waste bags. Nothing longer than 4 feet or thicker than 4 inches.

tipping_fee_note: The association pays Frederick County by the ton for everything sent to the transfer station. Those tipping fees are the single largest line item in the budget, which means recycling is not just tidy — it directly holds your assessment down.
